room.square.title: Square
room.square.description: An open square. A road leads west; steps go down south to a cellar. [Stakes](stakes) mark a plot.
room.road.title: Road
room.road.description: A dirt road. The square is east; hills rise north; cottages lie west; a storehouse stands south.
settle.arrival_line: A dog barks somewhere down the road.
item.npc_corpse.description: A still body in the dust.
room.hills.title: Hills
room.hills.description: Bare hills above the road, which lies south.
npc.raider.description: A raider with a notched knife.
room.storehouse.title: Storehouse
room.storehouse.description: A plank storehouse. The road is north.
room.cottages.title: Cottages
room.cottages.description: A row of cottages. The road is east.
room.cellar.title: Cellar
room.cellar.description: A cool cellar under the square. Steps lead north.
room.far_road.title: Far road
detail.stakes: Stakes mark out a building plot.
service.buy_charter.used: The reeve hands you the town charter.
blueprint.smithy.title: The smithy
blueprint.smithy.description: A smithy with a cold forge.
blueprint.mill.title: The mill
narration.raise_smithy.success: You raise a smithy north of the square.
settle.smith_arrives: A smith has come to town.
item.chest.description: A heavy chest of the town.
